body.name: ChimeraOS 49-2 (cabd8c9)
body.body:
Manually built transition release to new update system.

Identical to 49-1 except it includes an updated version of `frzr` and additional dependencies required by that version.

NOTE: Tag is not accurate. GitHub uses date of commit, so must be set to a newer commit than 49-1.

body.name: GamerOS 15
body.body:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD DIRECTLY FROM THE RELEASES PAGE.
GO TO https://gamer-os.github.io FOR DOWNLOAD AND INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS.

Key components:
- linux 5.5.4
- mesa 19.3.4
- nvidia 440.59
- steamos-compositor-plus 1.4.1
- steam-tweaks 0.2.2
- steam-buddy 0.3.0
- retroarch 1.8.4

Changelog:
- added support for uploading and playing Atari 2600 games
- removed plymouth bootsplash due to reliability issues
- fixed steam-tweaks crash when adding launch options under certain conditions
- added Xbox One dongle support (xow)
- added mangohud
- added Feral gamemode
- added NTP support
- improved /etc overlay handling
- reduced system download size by 25%
- reduced installation/upgrade time

body.name: GamerOS 12
body.body:
Key components:
- linux 5.4.8
- mesa 19.3.1
- nvidia 440.44
- steam-tweaks 0.2.1
- steamos-compositor-plus 1.4.1
- steam-buddy 0.2.2
- retroarch 1.8.1

Changelog:
- added support for uploading and playing Nintendo 64 and TurboGrafx-16 games
- fixed Steam Controller not working with RetroArch
- added support for Alienware Steam Machine lights
- added support for automatic injection of per game launch options
- include Codemasters cert for Dirt Rally 2.0 online mode
- fixed frzr-unlock command failing

body.name: GamerOS 10
body.body:
Key components:
- linux 5.3.13.1
- mesa 19.2.6
- nvidia 440.36
- steam-tweaks 0.1.3
- steamos-compositor-plus 1.4.1
- steam-buddy 0.1.4

Changelog:
- a notification is now shown when a restart is required to complete an update
- fixed partition detection under certain conditions during installation
- minor bug fixes to steam-tweaks
- added steam-buddy, a web based tool for installing apps from flathub and uploading ROMs for various systems

body.name: gamerOS 5
body.body:
- linux 5.2.13
 - mesa 19.1.6
 - nvidia 435.21
 - add steam-tweaks
    - automatically whitelist additional games for Proton
    - automatically enable Steam Input for games on a whitelist
 - UEFI support
 - use Plymouth for cleaner boot
 - fix failure to install to NVMe drives
 - can now view release version under Settings->System
 - added extra fonts
 - added trim support
 - bluetooth headset support
 - use prebuilt initramfs
